games.name: The Ranchers
games.summary: Guides, map, database and planning tools for The Ranchers.
games.zhSummary: 《牧场主》的攻略、地图、资料库和规划工具。

tasks.label: Prepare building materials
tasks.summary: Choose a blueprint and compare its materials with your shared stock.
tasks.zhSummary: 选择蓝图，按已有库存计算还缺哪些材料。

tasks.label: Troubleshoot chicken care
tasks.summary: Start from a symptom, then check the relevant care steps and sources.
tasks.zhSummary: 从不吃食、不下蛋或消失等症状进入对应排查步骤。

tasks.label: Track a quest
tasks.summary: Keep a local checklist and open the matching walkthrough.
tasks.zhSummary: 保存本地任务进度，并打开对应任务的完整步骤。

games.name: Farming Simulator 25
games.summary: Bread, canola oil and greenhouse water planning for Farming Simulator 25.
games.zhSummary: 面向《模拟农场25》的面包、菜籽油与温室供水规划工具。

tasks.label: Check bread supply
tasks.summary: Work backwards to flour and wheat, then check the mill shortfall.
tasks.zhSummary: 从面包目标反算面粉、小麦，检查磨坊是否够用。

tasks.label: Plan canola oil
tasks.summary: Calculate canola demand and additional Oil Mills from your target.
tasks.zhSummary: 按产量目标计算菜籽需求与还需新增的油厂。

tasks.label: Plan greenhouse water
tasks.summary: Compare water demand with your stock and estimate tanker trips.
tasks.zhSummary: 比较用水需求与现有水量，按自填水车容量估算运输趟数。
